summary: Phase 2 Missions (5 isolated wallets + withdrawal flow + admin manage). Backend: 19/19 pytest assertions PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_mission_withdrawals.py covering wallet listing, withdrawal create/balance-decrement, insufficient/invalid wallet/amount validation, admin list+filter, validate-keeps-reserved, reject-refunds, idempotent double-action, 404/400 edge cases, stats endpoint, mission CRUD, and auth gating. Frontend: Admin UI fully verified end-to-end via Playwright — 3 tabs (Missions / Retraits / Stats) all render with correct testIDs (admin-missions-tab-missions|withdrawals|stats). Stats tab shows total_missions=1, active=1, completions=0, active_users=0, total_rewards=0 with per-type breakdown for all 5 wallets. Retraits tab renders filter chips (En attente/Validées/Rejetées/Toutes) and empty-state correctly. Add mission form opens with all required fields: m-title, m-desc, m-type-*, m-upload-pick (MediaUploader 'Importer une vidéo'), m-url, m-duration, m-reward, m-q, m-ans, m-exp, m-active, m-save, m-cancel.

minor.issue: Balance decrement is not atomic (read-then-write). Concurrent requests could race past balance check. Low-traffic acceptable but consider conditional update: db.users.update_one({'id': uid, bal_field: {'$gte': amount}}, {'$inc': {bal_field: -amount}}) and check modified_count.

integration_issues.issue: Admin user is routed to (admin)/missions group, so the user-side wallet cards (testID wallet-{type}, wallet-{type}-withdraw, WithdrawModal) could NOT be directly e2e-tested under the admin account. Code review of /app/frontend/app/(app)/missions.tsx confirms 5 wallet cards, disabled-when-zero logic, WithdrawModal with testIDs mission-withdraw-modal/amount/submit/cancel are all correctly implemented. Needs a non-admin seeded user to validate UI end-to-end.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Make /api/me/mission-withdrawals atomic via conditional $inc to avoid the read-then-write race.

(Optional) Seed a non-admin test user (e.g. tester@example.com) and pre-credit balance_youtube so future testing agents can validate the user-side WithdrawModal flow end-to-end without depending on a real registration that requires sponsor approval.
Confirm with product that admin landing on /missions intentionally shows admin UI (it does, via Expo Router group precedence). If admin should also see the user wallets, expose a switcher.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/missions.py POST /me/mission-withdrawals — race condition (read-then-write balance). Recommend atomic conditional update.

backend/missions.py admin_mission_withdrawal_action — Correctly guards w.status != 'pending' so double-validate/double-reject return 400. Refund on reject uses $inc back to bal_field — verified working at API level (bal_before = bal_after).
backend/missions.py admin_create_mission — Stores `created_by = who.get('username')`; spec OK. Note: doc returned to client is the dict before mongo insert; safe (no _id leak).
frontend (admin)/missions.tsx — Both MediaUploader and m-url TextInput write to the same `editing.url`, providing two equivalent ways to set the link (per spec). Clean.

frontend (app)/missions.tsx — WithdrawModal correctly disables submit when balance<=0 and shows the warning message. Wallet cards remain rendered even when window_open=false (verified by reading load() which fetches wallets/withdrawals/history independently of windowOpen).
Both pages handle errors with `e?.detail` from api wrapper and surface via window.alert (web) or Alert.alert (native) — consistent UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% admin UI (all 3 tabs, MediaUploader, mission form). User-side UI: code-reviewed only, not e2e (no test user available).
